'''The Nine Horse Hitch''' is an [[inn]] in [[Lugard]]. 

[[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]], [[Min Farshaw]] and [[Logain Ablar]] stop there briefly while Siuan tries to find out where the Blue Ajah is located.{{ref/book|5|11}}
